armyRules.name: Oath of Moment
armyRules.effect: Inherited from base Space Marines. See Space-Marines.rules-verified.json.

armyRules.name: Chapter Restriction
armyRules.effect: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter. Cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models. Additional model exclusions apply per the base Space Marines Chapters rule (GLADIATOR LANCER, GLADIATOR REAPER, GLADIATOR VALIANT, IMPULSOR, REPULSOR, REPULSOR EXECUTIONER unless they have the Black Templars keyword).

battleFormations.name: Companions of Vehemence
battleFormations.effect: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. RESTRICTIONS: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

artefacts.name: Chorus of Relentless Hate
artefacts.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit and add 1 to Advance rolls made for it.

artefacts.name: Sacred Rage
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

artefacts.name: Unnamed AP Enhancement
artefacts.effect: [CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR model only] Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit by 1.

artefacts.name: Unnamed Strength Enhancement
artefacts.effect: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit.

artefacts.name: Unnamed Invulnerable Save Enhancement
artefacts.effect: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

artefacts.name: Unnamed Stealth Enhancement
artefacts.effect: [BLACK TEMPLARS model only] Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.

sourceNotes: LOW CONFIDENCE per source: only Companions of Vehemence detachment is verified in full; Vindication Task Force/Godhammer Assault Force/Marshal's Household/The Living Miracle/Wrathful Procession names are confirmed to exist (via Stratagem refs) but their rule text, DP cost and Enhancements are NOT captured (defaulted to 2 DP) and need direct Wahapedia verification.
